name: EURUSD strength as a dollar-weakness proxy — long crypto beta on a broad euro-led dollar breakdown
rationale: MECHANISM: a distinct expression of the dollar-weakness thesis using the deepest, most liquid FX pair (EURUSD) rather than the trade-weighted DXY basket — EURUSD is ~57% of the DXY weight but trades with tighter spreads and cleaner flow, so a decisive euro up-thrust is an early, high-signal read of broad dollar weakness that loosens global conditions and re-rates risk. Long crypto beta when eurusd breaks higher (positive RoC) AND crypto confirms (positive medium-term ret_Nd). Counterparty = slow-clock FX/rates allocators. DISCONFIRMER: same sign-flip risk as the DXY variants — if the BTC-dollar inverse tie has flipped positive in the 2024-2026 ETF cycle (JPMorgan Mar 2026), a dollar-weakness long is backwards. Kill unless strictly OOS 2024-2026 keeps the inverse alive net of fees. Also kill if EURUSD and DXY variants (hh-macro-09/10) are economically identical (EURUSD dominates DXY) — keep only the cleaner of the FX reads.
catalyst: euro-led dollar breakdown with a confirming crypto uptrend
